title: Light Earthy Thai Teque Os Tom Kha
description: A post-workout Thai dish featuring pre-fried teque os in a creamy and earthy tom kha sauce, perfect for a quick and nourishing meal.
instructions: Heat the coconut milk in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they are tender.
Add the sliced galangal and lemon grass to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pre-fried teque os to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the fish sauce and lime juice to the pot and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped Thai basil.
Serve the tom kha hot, garnished with additional Thai basil if desired.
Cook the teque os according to the package instructions before using.
Adjust the amount of fish sauce and lime juice to taste.
